changelog:
ASO skill version 1.0.0 initial release:

- Provides detailed checklists and rules for App Store Optimization (ASO) across iOS and Android, including keyword research, metadata, visuals, testing, and localization.
- Covers A/B testing strategies and conversion optimization techniques.
- Outlines review management and analytics best practices.
- Includes new reference documents and evaluation criteria to guide ASO audits.
- Reorganizes documentation for clarity; removes the old skill-card.
summary: When the user wants to audit or optimize an App Store or Google Play listing. Also use when the user mentions 'ASO audit,' 'app store optimization,' 'optimize my app listing,' 'improve app visibility,' 'app store ranking,' 'audit my listing,' 'why aren't people downloading my app,' 'improve my app conversion,' 'keyword optimization for app,' or 'compare my app to competitors.' Use when the user shares an App Store or Google Play URL and wants to improve it.
